# Idea: Guided onboarding

## Problem or Opportunity

Prospective customers may need additional guidance after creating an account in F-001.

## Proposal

Present a fictional guided checklist after the account creation step.

## Expected Value

The checklist could clarify the next actions in the onboarding journey.

## Scope and Considerations

This idea is fictional demonstration data and is not committed implementation scope.

## Next Step

Assess the idea against [F-001: Customer onboarding](../../features/F-001-customer-onboarding/feature.md).
